program.name: Sweat & Lift Shuffle
program.subject: Variety
program.blurb: Cardio or combat in a new shape every day, then a short lift.
program.about: Conditioning first, never the same way twice, then a short strength block. Each day deals HIIT, jumps, running drills, court moves, sprints, footwork, kettlebell cardio, boxing or kickboxing and more, in a circuit, an EMOM, straight sets or supersets. A short lift of squats, presses and rows follows. Level II adds reps and Level III moves you one weight up.
program.split: Every day different · cardio & combat, then a lift
